What happens if every human disappeared right now? We trace the timeline from the first power outages to the final decay of our cities.

When the lights go out, the world changes faster than you might expect. This documentary explores the immediate aftermath of humanity vanishing, examining how power grids fail and infrastructure begins to collapse. We follow the progression of time as nature reclaiming cities becomes the new reality, with forests creeping into urban centers and wildlife returning to environments once dominated by skyscrapers.

As the centuries pass, the scars of our civilization fade. We analyze how buildings decay without maintenance and eventually crumble into dust. By looking at the Earth without humans, we gain a new perspective on the resilience of the planet and the temporary nature of our global footprint. This is a look at the eventual state of a world left entirely to the wild.
